hanuman-bahuk.title: Hanumān Bāhuk
hanuman-bahuk.author: Tulsīdās
hanuman-bahuk.authority_note: A digitized 2016 reading edition. It is an identified textual witness, not a critical edition and not authority to overwrite an audible performance variant.
hanuman-bahuk.comparison_policy: Audio is authoritative for this recording. The witness supplies an independently digitized candidate reading: compare it after the first audio draft, use it to focus a second audio audit, retain every audible performance variant, and leave an unresolved disagreement blocked rather than silently selecting the witness.
